text: Residents can visit the community centre to receive help with digital services.
referenceTranslation: 居民可以前往社区中心，获取数字服务方面的帮助。

text: 志愿者将在周末为独居老人派送餐食。
referenceTranslation: Volunteers will deliver meals to elderly people living alone over the weekend.

text: The health screening is free for eligible residents aged forty and above.
referenceTranslation: 符合资格的四十岁及以上居民可以免费接受健康检查。

text: 社区活动旨在鼓励不同年龄和文化背景的居民相互交流。
referenceTranslation: The community activity aims to encourage interaction among residents of different ages and cultural backgrounds.

text: Families facing financial difficulties may approach the social service office for assistance.
referenceTranslation: 面临经济困难的家庭可以向社会服务办事处寻求援助。

text: 公共图书馆将延长开放时间，以满足学生和上班族的需求。
referenceTranslation: The public library will extend its opening hours to meet the needs of students and working adults.

text: The programme brings together healthcare providers and community partners to support active ageing.
referenceTranslation: 该计划汇集医疗服务提供者和社区伙伴，共同支持积极乐龄。

text: 有关机构将加强外展工作，确保弱势群体能够及时获得所需服务。
referenceTranslation: The relevant agencies will strengthen outreach efforts to ensure that vulnerable groups can receive the services they need in a timely manner.

text: Residents are encouraged to provide feedback on how shared public spaces can be made safer and more accessible.
referenceTranslation: 当局鼓励居民就如何让共享公共空间更安全、更便利提出意见。

text: 为了建设更具包容性的社会，公共服务必须考虑残障人士的实际需要。
referenceTranslation: To build a more inclusive society, public services must take into account the practical needs of persons with disabilities.
